summary: NOSEFO TAU AS (org. no. 987 929 375) is a private limited company (AS) based in Strand, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2005-03-05. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 85.597 (Annen undervisning ellers); it has 9 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 12.8 m and net income was -NOK 172 415. CEO: Frode Skarstein; board chair: Ivar Sørensen; auditor: FORUS REVISJON AS.
